description: This file defines the LDAPService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing LDAP integration functions such as connection handling, LDAP queries, and credential binding, utilizing Symfony LDAP components.

classes.name: LDAPService
classes.description: Service class providing LDAP connectivity, query, and binding functionalities within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAP adapter instance.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds credentials to the LDAP connection.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates an LDAP query with specified distinguished name, query string, and options.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in LDAP filters.
